policy: Admit when an original statement by the dataset creators permits research training use: card or README text, a licence file covering data distributed with it, the release archive's licence, or the creator's own Hub licence declaration (card metadata on the creator's repository). A tag set by someone else (a mirror) or a code-repository licence alone is not a basis. Explicit upstream restrictions are recorded; upstream terms that cannot be found are recorded as missing, not as prohibitions. Permission to train is recorded separately from redistribution; nothing is redistributed. NC terms are not a reason to exclude. Media origin is recorded; per-image rights of scraped or web media are not independently verified.

fv_ai2d.conflicting_statement: AI2's dataset page allenai.org/data/diagrams (Wayback captures 2021-2024; now a redirect to the zip) and the AWS Open Data listing allenai-diagrams.yaml (awslabs/open-data-registry PR #915, submitted by AI2 in April 2021, unchanged since) both say CC BY-SA (4.0 deed). No document found says which governs; the build follows the bundled licence. See ai2d-terms.json and docs/steps/05-data.md#ai2d-terms
fv_ai2d.media_correction: basis_and_media (copied from the v2 recipe terms_note) says the diagrams were collected by AI2 and covered by the same licence. The AI2D paper (arXiv 1603.07396, p. 9) says they were collected by scraping Google Image Search; per-image rights are not established by either AI2 licence. The recipe text is left as built because it is hashed into the v2 manifest and scan fingerprints

rl_virl39k.basis_and_media: Creator's Hub declaration: TIGER-Lab/ViRL39K card metadata 'license: mit' on TIGER-Lab's own repository, covering the released questions, answers and images.zip; the card has no prose terms. Upstreams by the per-row source field (provenance.upstream_source): ScienceQA and ScienceQAConverted, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and 'non-commercial research purposes only'; ai2d, AI2's licence (academic non-profit use, no redistribution); chartqa, GPL-3.0; MMMath (THU-KEG/MM_Math), M3CoT and DeepScaleR, MIT; R1OneVision, Apache-2.0; MMK12, MMK12Converted, K12, dvqa and geoqa_plus, no terms found (missing, not a restriction); Processed, collected by the creators. The card also lists LLaVA-OneVision-Data, which allows 'academic research and education purpose' only; the source field does not mark which rows came from it. Media: images from these datasets and newly collected ones
rl_virl39k.redistribution: not cleared: the MIT declaration cannot relicense upstream data. ScienceQA rows are NC-SA, ai2d rows may not be redistributed, chartqa rows are GPL-3.0, LLaVA-OneVision-derived rows are academic-only, and several upstreams state no terms
rl_virl39k.previous: pending in v2: only a 'license: mit' Hub tag

rl_vwi_verified.basis_and_media: Creator's Hub declaration: TIGER-Lab/VisualWebInstruct-verified card metadata 'license: mit' on TIGER-Lab's own repository, covering the released QA pairs and images; no prose terms. The parent TIGER-Lab/VisualWebInstruct declares 'license: apache-2.0'. Media, per the parent card: web images found through Google Image Search (118,576 of the parent's images) and images from coco, chartqa, ai2d, geoqa+, sqa (ScienceQA), vg, docvqa, gqa, ocr_vqa and textvqa. Rows carry no image source, so upstream restrictions (ScienceQA CC BY-NC-SA research only, AI2D no redistribution, ChartQA GPL-3.0) attach to rows only through image matching; rights in the web images are not stated
rl_vwi_verified.redistribution: not cleared: the MIT declaration cannot relicense web images or upstream data with their own terms (ScienceQA NC-SA, AI2D no redistribution, ChartQA GPL-3.0), and rows carry no image source
rl_vwi_verified.previous: pending in v2: only a 'license: mit' Hub tag
